purpose: Define the PR evidence, release path, deploy smoke evidence, and rollback metadata required before release-sensitive changes land or promote.

required_evidence: Changed files and affected runtime or process surfaces.
Risk classification with rationale and protected-surface impact.
Exact verification commands with pass, fail, blocked, or skipped status.
Contract validation evidence for machine-readable release or work-item artifacts.
Deploy or smoke evidence for release-impacting changes, or an explicit credential/environment blocker.
Reviewer checklist for auth, billing, tenancy, audit, webhook, approval, schema, deploy, and public-claim surfaces when touched.
ready_done_confirmation: Definition of Ready was met before implementation, or gaps are named in the PR.
Definition of Done is met before merge, or blockers and next safe steps are named in the PR.
Runtime behavior, dependencies, migrations, workflows, and deploy behavior are unchanged or explicitly described.
release_path: Work lands on a scoped branch.
A PR carries evidence, risk, rollout, rollback, and residual-risk notes.
Required local or CI checks pass, or a blocker-specific substitute is documented and approved.
Production-sensitive changes deploy to staging before production promotion where credentials permit.
Production promotion records smoke, health, and rollback-target evidence.

release.rollback_action: Redeploy the last known-good Cloudflare worker versions for web, api, and workflows, then rerun npm run smoke:cloudflare.

service_targets.required_target: Last known-good Cloudflare Worker version ID or dashboard rollback target for the web surface.
service_targets.post_rollback_check: Run npm run smoke:cloudflare and confirm the web health or route smoke result.

service_targets.required_target: Last known-good Cloudflare Worker version ID or dashboard rollback target for the api surface.
service_targets.post_rollback_check: Run npm run smoke:cloudflare and confirm /health responds successfully.

service_targets.required_target: Last known-good Cloudflare Worker version ID or dashboard rollback target for workflows.
service_targets.post_rollback_check: Run npm run smoke:cloudflare and confirm workflow smoke or health evidence when workflows are in scope.

required_fields: affected Cloudflare services: web, api, workflows, or explicit none for metadata-only changes
last known-good Worker version IDs or dashboard rollback targets for every affected Cloudflare service
rollback_metadata.metadata_only_exception: For metadata-only changes with no deployed service impact, state that no Cloudflare service rollback is required and the PR can be closed or reverted.

rollback_metadata_required: affected Cloudflare services: web, api, workflows, or explicit none for metadata-only changes
last known-good Worker version IDs or dashboard rollback targets for every affected Cloudflare service
abort_conditions: billing checkout, portal, or webhook verification fails
dashboard truth is wrong or unavailable
approval-required workflow can dispatch without approval
public pricing or claims become materially inaccurate

required_for_release: CI or local substitute gate results.
Staging deploy result for production-sensitive changes where credentials permit.
npm run smoke:cloudflare result or blocked reason.
Healthcheck status for API and web surfaces.
Workflow healthcheck status when workflows are in scope.
Rollback target confirmation for Cloudflare web, api, and workflows before production promotion, or an explicit metadata-only no-service-rollback note.
deploy_evidence.credential_blocker_policy: If Cloudflare credentials or environment variables are unavailable, record the missing prerequisite and do not claim deploy or smoke success.

current_mission_evidence.scope: Dirty-worktree quarantine, production-grade continuous improvement contract validation, advisory repo contract validation, PR evidence, rollback posture, and current verification evidence.

pull_request.checks_observed: At evidence-capture time, GitHub checks were green for the previously pushed branch commit; any final commit produced by this node must be pushed and observed before merge.

pre_existing_wip.policy: Preserved and layered on additively; not discarded, hidden, or reverted.

verification_evidence.scope: Python syntax gate for changed advisory contract validator.

verification_evidence.command: node -e "for (const path of ['.jarvis/production_grade_profile.json','.jarvis/pr_evidence_manifest.json','agile_work_item.json','.jarvis/agile_work_item.json','.jarvis/dirty_worktree_quarantine_2026-05-24_node-0972c3bef4bd.json']) JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(path,'utf8')); console.log('json parse ok')"

Strict advisory validation for production-grade profile ownership, continuous_improvement, agile work item, PR evidence, rollback metadata, and PR template. Result: 256 pass, 0 warn, 0 error.
Repo operating-system audit; score 100%, no priority gaps, git_dirty true while PR-ready edits were uncommitted.
Required medium-risk lint/type gate across workspaces.
Required automated test suite. Final result: root 24, API 63, web 19, database 1, shared 2 tests passed.
Required build and release bundle gate.

Credential-dependent Cloudflare smoke. Result: WEB_APP_URL is required.

Blocked because /etc/cynik/apps/sales-saas.env is not readable and WEB_APP_URL, API_HEALTHCHECK_URL, WORKFLOWS_HEALTHCHECK_URL, WORKFLOWS_HEALTHCHECK_TOKEN, and CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN are unset.
No runtime service restart is required or authorized for metadata and test-tooling release-readiness artifacts.
Actual last known-good Cloudflare Worker version IDs or dashboard rollback targets require Cloudflare environment access and were not confirmable locally.

rollback_metadata.rollback_owner: DevOps release owner for the PR.
rollback_metadata.schema_or_data_compatibility_constraints: No schema, migration, data, billing, auth, tenancy, provider webhook, or runtime contract change.
rollback_metadata.metadata_only_rollback_action: Revert the PR or restore the previous versions of .codex/scripts/validate_repo_contracts.py, .jarvis/production_grade_profile.json, .jarvis/pr_evidence_manifest.json, .jarvis/dirty_worktree_quarantine_2026-05-24_node-0972c3bef4bd.json, and docs/platform/release-readiness-report.md.
rollback_metadata.production_service_rollback_action_if_bu: Redeploy the last known-good Cloudflare worker versions for web, api, and workflows, then rerun npm run smoke:cloudflare.
post_rollback_validation: node -e JSON parse for changed contract files
npm run smoke:cloudflare when runtime services were deployed or rolled back

unresolved_risks: GitHub checks for the final pushed commit from this pass must be observed before merge.
Cloudflare staging or production deploy was not authorized by this release-readiness mission.
Cloudflare smoke remains blocked until environment-backed URLs and credentials are available.
Actual last known-good Cloudflare Worker rollback targets remain unconfirmed without Cloudflare provider access.
Production-grade alert wiring and dashboards remain documented expectations, not verified runtime evidence.

non_goals: This manifest does not deploy services.
This manifest does not replace PR review, CI, or production owner approval.
This manifest does not authorize bypassing rollback or smoke evidence.
